presets.label: EVOLVED RUNNER
presets.note: Fastest champion of the study: 13.7 m in 10 s on flat ground (1.4 m/s), one hop and no tumbling. It skips rather than runs: its single hop peaks at 0.68 m.

presets.label: EVOLVED INCHWORM
presets.note: Furthest flat-ground low traveller: 15.3 m in 10 s with the centre of mass never more than 0.31 m up.
